method: As the step 17 Fire comparison: whole fragments compared to pdftotext 4.00 -raw -enc UTF-8 output of each physical PDF page, with line endings normalized to LF; the fragment loses its Markdown markup (tags only, never an escaped < or > sign), and both sides lose ligatures, punctuation, case, and whitespace; each normalized fragment occurs whole in its normalized page text, or in two parts where a page break or an example interrupts it. The rules of the backlog pass 16 (night and weather: E1 Night, E3 Weather, the B25.65 Wind Change DR, and the B.8 Random Direction), 2026-09-29; an independent referee agent reviews the rulings that rest on them.

subjects.note: A boxed example or a column break interrupts the rule; the two parts each occur whole in the page text.
